# The names that LOOK like a path into this repository and are not one.
#
# One `<name> <reason>` per line. TestEveryNamedRepoPathExists checks this list in BOTH
# directions: a name that is missing from the tree and not listed here is a red run, and a
# listed name that nothing writes any more -- or that is IN the tree now -- is also a red
# run. So the list only ever gets shorter, and a row parks nothing.
#
# There are three honest reasons to be here, and they are the three sections below. The
# first is by far the largest, and it is the one worth reading as a list: it is every file
# a specification has PLANNED and nobody has written yet. Shrink-only means the row is
# deleted on the day the file appears, by the test, out loud.

# --- 1. A specification's plan: a file the spec says will exist, not yet written. ---

docs/templates SPEC-CI cardtemplates: one of CardTemplateDirs, skipped until a template is written there
internal/pkgvalid PROPOSAL-TOKENS-RECORDS-185's plan: the package the proposal would add
internal/pulse/cardheader.go the typed-header grammar that lands with #1721; lintheader.go names it as the parser not yet in this tree
internal/pulse/kinds.go SPEC-TOOLWORK §5's kinds-table file; the six kinds live in cutkind.go until the accept gate's table is one file of its own
internal/tokens/message.go SPEC-TOKENS' plan: the message record
tools/templates SPEC-CI cardtemplates: one of CardTemplateDirs, skipped until a template is written there

# --- 2. An invented example: a name chosen to show the SHAPE of a path. ---

.github/scripts/foo.sh SPEC-CI.md's invented script in `x=$(bash ...)`, shown as something that is not a producer
.github/seat-rule-gate.sh SPEC-SECRETS.md names the workflow script that is deliberately NOT here: the rule lives in the tool instead
docs/bus internal/bus/git.go's failure narrative: a bus directory pointed inside a larger repository
docs/bus/from-bo/x.md the path that same narrative says git reports from the repository root
docs/history SPEC.md's `--allow docs/history` example for subdirectory enumeration
internal/decide/entry.go internal/swarm/lintbase.go's class-9 story: the PATHS entry card-nx-f19 named that did not exist at its base
internal/secretsanta/ SPEC-RELEASE.md's example of what prefix matching on `internal/secrets` would also catch

# --- 3. A path in another tree: another repository, another branch, or a retired file. ---

docs/nova-lessons.md the lessons file lives in the self repository; internal/pulse/watch.go cites it as the source of its rules
scripts/coordination/ a prefix in SPEC-RELEASE.md's sensitive-path list, kept in the list though the directory is retired
docs/SPEC-PULSE.md deleted with the frozen nova-pulse (2026-09-24); the line naming it is history
internal/pulse/fleetstandard.go deleted with the frozen nova-pulse (2026-09-24); the line naming it is history
cmd/nova-pulse/testdata deleted by #3801 (card cut in nova-sprint, #3789); the line naming it is history
